moments.title: THE UNC BOWL
moments.history: Forty-one-year-old Aaron Rodgers and forty-year-old Joe Flacco traded touchdowns on Thursday night. Rodgers hit Pat Freiermuth for a 68-yard score to put Pittsburgh ahead 31-30 with 2:21 left. Flacco answered with completions to Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, setting up Evan McPherson's winning 36-yard field goal with seven seconds remaining. Cincinnati won 33-31.
moments.goal: Lead Flacco and the Bengals downfield to beat Rodgers and the Steelers.
moments.stadium_note: Retail Paul Brown Stadium geometry: same physical venue renamed Paycor; dedicated White Bengal field.
moments.evidence: PFR indexed boxscore verifies date,venue,final score,scoring and QB totals. Full PFR request403; official NFL gamebook verifies starters,first scrimmage snap,weather,timeouts and drive. Ratings are estimates from the existing season model. Offline only.
